999008199.text: これが……歌姫ディオーナの歌……

localizations.en: So this is... the song of Diona the diva...

999008199.text:
ノーヴァ神聖国の歌姫ともまた違う。
聞き入るとは、まさにこのこと

localizations.en: It's different from the divas of Nova. This is what it truly means to be captivated by song.

999008199.text: 歌姫いいなぁ、憧れるっすわぁ

localizations.en: Being a diva sounds so nice. I'm totally jealous!

999008199.text:
それを神聖国で言わないようにね。場合によっては
神官長に怒られるわよ

localizations.en: Try not to say that back in Nova. The High Priest might scold you, depending on the circumstances.

999008199.text: 歌も歌える案内人錬金術士、そんな可能性もある

localizations.en: A Star Guide alchemist who can also sing—now there's a possibility!

999008199.text: 欲張りな姉様。むしろそこがいいところ

localizations.en: Always so ambitious, Alvina. Though that's one of your best qualities.

999008199.text: あ、アルビーナたち、ここにいたんだ

localizations.en: Oh, there you are! I was looking for you guys.

999008199.text:
いい所に席取ってるわね。
隣いいかしら？

localizations.en: You've got great seats here. Mind if we sit with you?

999008199.text: もち！　一緒に聞こう！
うん、それじゃあお邪魔して……
わあ……景色も相まって、すごく幻想的だね……

localizations.en: Wow... with this scenery, it's so magical...

999008199.text:
いいのかねえ。こんなにゆったりしてて。
やらなくちゃいけないこと、たくさんある気がするのに

localizations.en: I wonder if this is okay. Being so relaxed like this when it feels like we have so many things we need to be doing.

999008199.text:
いいんじゃねえか？
普段頑張ってる自分たちへのご褒美くらい

localizations.en: What's wrong with it? Think of it as a reward for all the hard work you've been putting in.

999008199.text:
こんな時間がなきゃ、次また頑張ることが
できなくなるだろ

localizations.en: Without moments like these, you won't be able to keep pushing forward, right?

999008199.text:
それに、皆さんここ最近はずっと船の上ですからね。
気付かないところで心も身体も疲れていると思います

localizations.en: Besides, everyone's been on ships constantly lately. You're probably more tired in body and spirit than you realize.

999008199.text:
思いっきり楽しんだり、綺麗だと目を奪われたり、
心地よい歌に耳を傾けたり、ゆったりしたり……

localizations.en: Having fun with everything you've got, being mesmerized by beautiful sights, listening to wonderful songs, taking it easy...

999008199.text:
それも全部、これからの旅に向けて
必要なことなのではないでしょうか

localizations.en: All of that is necessary for the journey ahead, don't you think?

999008199.text: さすが天使ちゃん、いいこと言うぜ

localizations.en: That's our angel—always knows just what to say.

999008199.text: ……それもそっか

じゃあ、今を目いっぱい楽しんでおかなきゃ。
また旅に戻った時に頑張れるように

localizations.en: Then we should enjoy this moment to the fullest. So we can give it our all when we get back to traveling.

999008199.text:
そして旅で全力を尽くそ。
また、こんなゆったりしたときを過ごせるように

localizations.en: And we'll put everything we have into the journey. So we can have peaceful moments like this again.

999008199.text: ……うん
